Allied Moulded Enclosure Products (India) Private Limited, subsidiary of Allied Moulded Products, Inc. USA, is the leading provider of worldwide product and service solutions for enclosing and protecting electrical and electronic systems.

(https://www.alliedmoulded.com/product-category/india/) Browse Now

Industrial Enclosures and Accessories

At Allied Moulded, we've grown to understand the needs of our customers in the demanding electrical industry and continue to be Your Trusted Source for all of your nonmetallic enclosure needs.

(https://www.alliedmoulded.com/product-category/india/) Browse Now

Superior Protection for your application

Our extensive line of high-performance fiberglass enclosures are designed to withstand the toughest elements and environments, and are protecting equipment across a wide array of industrial applications all over the world.

(https://www.alliedmoulded.com/product-category/india/) Browse Now

Full Range of Enclosure Accessories

We offer a full-range of accessory options to compliment your enclosure solution requirements. From back panels and hinged front panels, to hole plugs, HMI covers, ventilation kits, and much more, we've got you covered!

Browse Accessories

India Enclosure Products

Allied Moulded Enclosure Products (India) Private Limited, subsidiary of Allied Moulded Products, Inc. USA, is the leading provider of worldwide product and service solutions for enclosing and protecting electrical and electronic systems.

Allied Moulded Enclosure Products’ state of the art, ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Jigani Bangalore, Karnataka, India, manufactures a wide range of enclosures meeting the strict standards for UL and NEMA certification.
